items.description: The Nossob is a dry river channel in the Kalahari region. It is better known for its valley than for year-round flow.
The Selinda Spillway is a seasonal water channel in northern Botswana. It links wetlands and floodplains when waters rise.
Mababe Depression is a low-lying basin near Botswana's northern wetland systems. It helps shape flood patterns and habitat.
Xudum Delta is part of the Okavango wetland landscape in northern Botswana. It is defined by channels, marshes, and islands.
Jwaneng Plateau is a raised landform near Jwaneng in southern Botswana. It sits within the broader Kalahari terrain.
Letlhakane Depression is a low-lying landscape feature near Letlhakane. It is part of the region's broad Kalahari relief.
